final: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name, AVG(CAST(Track.Bytes AS FLOAT) / Track.Milliseconds) as rate, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId WHERE Track.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Track.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate FROM media_type_rates) SELECT mtr.Name, mtr.rate, mtr.track_count, mtr.rate - om.mean_rate as rate_minus_mean FROM media_type_rates mtr CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE mtr.rate > om.mean_rate ORDER BY mtr.rate DESC
